summary: Deferred optimizer rollout caused sporadic tail-latency spikes; assistance with safe rewind
description:
Issue summary: Customer reported intermittent tail-latency spikes after enabling a deferred optimizer profile that adjusts batching thresholds and KV prefetch heuristics. The rollout targeted a subset of tenants on Dedicated capacity and used the 'defer-eager' gating flag.

Impact: Multiple production tenants experienced 95/99th percentile latency increases (2-5x) on interactive chat endpoints. No increased 5xx rate observed, but user-facing latency violated P99 SLO for affected tenants. Customer is on Dedicated plan and requested immediate guidance for a safe rewind.

Environment: Dedicated pool in us-east, mixed-quant profiles enabled per-tenant. Deploy timestamp: 2026-03-10 22:15 UTC. Snapshot label available: pre-opt-2026-03-10.

Observed behavior: Tail latency spikes concentrated on sessions that use long-context generation and streaming. Initial hypothesis from customer: KV cache invalidation races combined with a lower batching threshold introduced by the optimizer. Router shows traffic split (10% canary -> 90% baseline) but spikes persisted past canary window.

Request: Support asked to validate safe rollback steps, confirm snapshot restore procedure for tenant-scoped optimizer profiles, and provide a checklist to avoid request loss during rewind.

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) Use tenant TID-00923 with model llama-3-13b-v1.2 pinned.
2) Send multi-turn chat sequences with prefix length ~2k tokens.
3) Observe P99 token-latency after enabling optimizer profile 'defer-eager-v3'.

Logs/metrics provided: Link to customer dashboard and traces (redwood://dash/tenant/TID-00923/trace/2026-03-11), example request IDs: req-7a4f2c, req-9b0d1e. Attached CSV of percentile samples (uploaded to ticket).
comments: 2026-03-13 Priya Patel: Raised by ClearBridge Health after noticing spikes post-rollout. Customer requested immediate rollback guidance and assurance no requests will be lost.
2026-03-13 Marco Reyes: Acknowledged; planning to run quick telemetry sanity checks. Asked customer for access to tail traces and confirmation of snapshot label.

2026-03-13 SRE-Lead Liam O'Connor: Noted that similar signature seen before when KV eviction policy changed without widening prefetch window. Suggested verifying optimizer flag 'kv_prefetch_window' and batching threshold logs.
2026-03-14 Marco Reyes: Ran sampling on canary nodes; found increased KV cache misses correlated with threshold shift. Prepared safe rewind checklist and snapshot restore command sequence.
investigation_notes: Telemetry sampling: observed 3x increase in KV cache miss rate for affected tenant during canary traffic windows (samples from 2026-03-10 22:20 -> 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC).
Batching thresholds: optimizer set 'min_batch_size' lowered from 8 -> 3 for low-latency preference; led to higher small-batch overhead and more concurrent kernel invocations under mixed-tenant load.
KV invalidation: race observed when prefix-cache eviction policy ran concurrently with async prefetch; trace req-7a4f2c shows double fetch path causing 2x token latency for first streamed chunks.

Router: traffic gating was applied but the canary's failure domain overlapped with a GPU node group experiencing noisy-neighbor due to unrelated maintenance; increased variance amplified the optimizer effect.
resolution: Working resolution plan prepared; not yet executed. Recommended safe rewind steps provided to customer and engineering ops: 1) Pause optimizer flag 'defer-eager-v3' for affected tenant via tenant-config API (non-disruptive). 2) Trigger tenant-scoped snapshot restore to label 'pre-opt-2026-03-10' for optimizer profiles only (no model re-pull). 3) Increase telemetry sampling to 100% for 30 minutes post-rewind and monitor P95/P99. 4) If latency remains high, execute controlled node drain for canary GPU group to rule out noisy-neighbor. Additional follow-ups: implement automatic preflight that simulates KV miss amplification for future optimizer gates.
follow_up_actions: Create runbook entry for 'deferred-optimizer-safe-rewind' (owner: Marco Reyes)
Add preflight simulation to CI for optimizer changes (owner: Research/Applied ML)
Schedule post-incident review with ClearBridge Health (CS lead: Priya Patel)
Monitor affected tenant for 72 hours after rewind and report metrics to customer
